headline: Last session: Sensex and Nifty closed lower as inflation concerns weighed on Indian equity markets.

marketStatus.message: Market is closed today because it is a weekend. It will reopen on Monday, 16 November.

why: Inflation concerns weighed on market sentiment during the last trading session.
FII buying supported Sensex and Nifty to gain for the third consecutive week.
A global rotation trade away from AI tech stocks fueled interest in Indian equities.
Investors are watching key domestic and global factors this week to evaluate market direction.
whatHappening: On the last trading day, 13 November, Sensex fell 289 points and Nifty slipped lower.
Overall weekly trends remained positive with Sensex and Nifty recording a third straight week of gains.
An AI sector retreat globally is helping fuel a rotation trade back into Indian stocks.
The market is closed today, 15 November, for the weekend and will reopen on Monday.
summary: The Indian stock market is closed today, 15 November 2026, for the weekend. In the last trading session on Friday, Sensex fell 289 points due to inflation concerns, although markets achieved their third straight weekly gain driven by FII inflows. Trading will resume on Monday, 16 November.
